A pre-release is only ever an explicit target (<t3/>); nothing derives one. Raising a pre-release lands on the final it leads up to (<t4/> raised by a major, a minor or a patch is <t5/>), and a pre-release of the floor reaches it (<t6/>): with a floor of <t7/>, <t8/> is accepted, so an alpha series can continue, while nothing goes below a version already declared. The last release a plan measures from is the highest recorded version, a pre-release included; the stable pointer (<t9/>) never is one.

Pre-release je vždy jen explicitní cíl (<t3/>); žádný se neodvozuje. Zvýšení pre-release přistane na finální verzi, k níž vede (<t4/> zvýšená o major, minor či patch je <t5/>), a pre-release spodní meze ji dosáhne (<t6/>): se spodní mezí <t7/> se přijímá <t8/>, takže řada alfa může pokračovat, zatímco nic nejde pod už deklarovanou verzi.
